name: Apache - Detect Brute-Force on Protected Directories
description: An external IP produced 3+ HTTP 401 Unauthorized responses against a protected directory for a given username - HTTP auth brute-force / credential guessing.
alert_name: Apache - Detect Brute-Force on Protected Directories
alert_description:
What fired: >=3 HTTP 401 auth failures from one source IP against a protected URL/username - credential brute-force on HTTP basic/digest auth.

Why it matters: repeated auth failures indicate password guessing; success grants access to protected content.

Investigate:
  - Review the mapped source IP, targeted username and URL.
  - Check for a subsequent 200 (successful auth) from the same IP; consider blocking the IP / enforcing lockout.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1110 - Brute Force (TA0006 - Credential Access).
